title: fedia radiata
intro: Fedia radiata, commonly known as Horned Poppy, is a plant species in the family Boraginaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties that may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
